description: Read up to five public pages at once and get back the passages that answer an objective, e.g. 'the price of each plan' or 'who is on the leadership team'. Faster and cheaper than read_web_page for pulling specific facts, and handles PDFs. Pass full_content=true for the whole page as Markdown. Costs 1 credit per call.
